Privacy Policy - AppViewX

INTRODUCTION

Welcome to AppViewX, Inc.'s privacy policy.

AppViewX respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This privacy policy explains how we handle your personal information, your rights, and how the law protects you.

1. IMPORTANT INFORMATION AND WHO WE ARE

PURPOSE OF THIS PRIVACY POLICY

This policy outlines how AppViewX collects, processes, and protects your personal information when using our services, including when signing up for a webinar, requesting product information, or other interactions as described below.

This website and our services are not intended for children, and we do not knowingly collect data from them. If you believe we have inadvertently collected personal information from a minor, please contact us immediately.

CONTROLLER

AppViewX, Inc. is the data controller responsible for handling your personal information (referred to as "AppViewX," "we," "us," or "our" in this policy).

CONTACT DETAILS

If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our data practices, please contact us at:

AppViewX, Inc.

Email: support@appviewx.com

Postal Address:
City Hall,
222 Broadway,
New York, NY 10038

You also have the right to file a complaint with the European Data Protection Supervisor (www.edps.europa.eu).

CHANGES TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY

We regularly review our privacy policy. Any material changes will be communicated to you via email.

THIRD-PARTY LINKS

Our website may include links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for their privacy policies, so we encourage you to review their policies when leaving our site.

2. DATA WE COLLECT

We collect the following types of personal data:

  • Identity Data: Name, username, or similar identifiers.
  • Contact Data: Email addresses and phone numbers.
  • Transaction Data: Payment details and purchase history.
  • Technical Data: IP addresses and unique device IDs.
  • Geolocation Data: Real-world geographic location.
  • Professional Data: Employer information.

We do not collect special categories of personal data such as race, religion, or biometric data.

HOW WE COLLECT YOUR DATA

  • Direct interactions: When you create an account, subscribe, or contact us.
  • Automated technologies: Cookies, tracking tools, and similar technologies.
  • Third parties: Data aggregators and analytics providers.

3. HOW WE USE YOUR DATA

We process your data for the following reasons:

  • To fulfill contractual obligations.
  • For legitimate business interests.
  • To comply with legal requirements.

Forums and Chat Rooms

Any information you share in forums or chat rooms is publicly accessible. If you wish to remove personal data, contact us at support@appviewx.com.

PURPOSES FOR PROCESSING DATA
